artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a distinct, sharp black line that looks like a deep crack or split in the ball. Real baseballs do not crack open like this under normal conditions; this appears to be a generative artifact where the model failed to render a continuous surface, creating a nonsensical structural failure.

The edges of the black line are slightly blurred and lack the physical depth or shadowing expected from a real tear in thick leather, suggesting it is a painted-on artifact rather than a physical deformation.
